# Phase One — Bookshelf Revelation

The Awtsmoos remembers without being limited by memory or shelf;
Awtsmoos.com lets each saved teaching return as a luminous vessel, never a hidden style spell unto itself.

## Proven reality

- `ui/bookshelf.js` is live through `render.js` and `main.js`.
- Public contract: `renderBookshelf(bookmarks, { onOpen, onRemove })`.
- Current source is Git-clean before this Bookshelf wave.
- Current renderer mixes grouping, section construction, card construction, callback binding, empty state, runtime style injection, `innerHTML`, and `.onclick`.
- No static Bookshelf selectors exist in the loaded stylesheet graph.
- The runtime CSS is one compressed string and does not provide a complete explicit hover/active/focus-visible/disabled/reduced-motion contract.

## Possibility field

- Keep `renderBookshelf()` as the stable public gateway.
- Move grouping/render coordination into a `TiferesBookshelfView`.
- Move safe card/section construction into a `MalchusBookshelfCardFactory`.
- Use `textContent` for all saved bookmark data.
- Replace `.onclick` with `addEventListener`.
- Use explicit semantic buttons with 44px minimum touch targets.
- Keep Open and Remove visually distinct without clutter.
- Make cards responsive through `auto-fit` with a minimum that still works at 320px.
- Preserve folder vs track visual identity through classes, icon, and metadata—not browser-default controls.
- Give empty state deliberate glass/dashed styling.
- Add hover lift only on fine pointers.
- Add active press, focus-visible ring, disabled state, and reduced-motion fallback.
- Keep every style selector under the Rebbe Bookshelf root/classes so no global form/button leakage occurs.
- Import static Bookshelf CSS through `runtime-ui.css`.
- Add regression tests that fail if runtime style injection, `innerHTML`, or `.onclick` returns.
